chemistry_notes: Na-plagioclase feldspar; An content varies in natural samples; most RELAB samples are near pure albite (An <2)
polymorph_details: high albite C2/m above ~900-1000C vs low albite P-1 (triclinic) at STP; RELAB samples almost certainly low albite

chemistry_notes: grossular-andradite solid solution; Fe3+ dominant garnet; Ti substitution possible
polymorph_details: garnet group; no polymorphs at STP
structure_notes: nesosilicate; cubic garnet structure with isolated SiO4 tetrahedra

chemistry_notes: apatite supergroup; F-OH-Cl variants share same structure; RELAB mentions fluorapatite and one vanadinite sample
polymorph_details: hydroxylapatite fluorapatite chlorapatite all share P63/m; vanadinite Pb5(VO4)3Cl is different mineral same structure type
structure_notes: apatite supergroup; some RELAB samples may be vanadinite not apatite

chemistry_notes: clinopyroxene solid solution; not a single mineral species but compositional range in pyroxene quadrilateral; Ca-rich cpx
polymorph_details: pyroxene quadrilateral; augite spans a wide compositional range between diopside-hedenbergite and other cpx components; no true polymorphs but T-dependent ordering

chemistry_notes: beryl group; channel cyclosilicate; emerald variety contains Cr or V
polymorph_details: no polymorphs at STP; beryl is the only stable Be-Al silicate at ambient conditions
structure_notes: cyclosilicate with hexagonal channels; ring of 6 SiO4 tetrahedra

chemistry_notes: calcite group; Mg-calcite solid solution up to ~18 mol% MgCO3; RELAB includes Mg-calcite synthetic samples
polymorph_details: aragonite is the orthorhombic high-P polymorph but not in RELAB dataset; calcite itself is stable at STP
structure_notes: most common carbonate mineral; rhombohedral cleavage

chemistry_notes: Ca-Mg clinopyroxene; pure Mg end-member; Fe substitution gives hedenbergite CaFeSi2O6
polymorph_details: pure Mg end-member of clinopyroxene series; Fe2+ substitution produces hedenbergite

chemistry_notes: dolomite group; ordered CaMg carbonate; Fe-dolomite (ankerite) in RELAB
polymorph_details: ordered dolomite R-3 vs disordered protodolomite; Fe-dolomite ankerite Ca(Fe Mg)(CO3)2 is solid solution member
structure_notes: ordered CaMg carbonate; distinct from calcite by cation ordering; rhombohedral

chemistry_notes: Mg orthopyroxene; Fe end-member is ferrosilite Fe2Si2O6; RELAB samples are En-Fe mixtures
polymorph_details: low enstatite Pbca orthorhombic stable below ~1000C; high clinoenstatite P21/c monoclinic above; RELAB samples are low enstatite
structure_notes: orthopyroxene; Mg-Fe solid solution; single-chain inosilicate

chemistry_notes: grossular-andradite solid solution; Al dominant garnet; pure grossular is white, colorless
polymorph_details: garnet group; no polymorphs at STP

chemistry_notes: orthopyroxene; intermediate member of enstatite-ferrosilite series; typically En50-70
polymorph_details: same structure as enstatite; hypersthene is the Fe-rich orthopyroxene; En-Fs solid solution
structure_notes: orthopyroxene; Mg-Fe solid solution; single-chain inosilicate

chemistry_notes: K-feldspar; fully ordered triclinic polymorph; low-temperature stable form
polymorph_details: microcline triclinic ordered vs sanidine monoclinic disordered high-T vs orthoclase monoclinic partially ordered; RELAB samples are microcline
structure_notes: triclinic K-feldspar; fully ordered Al-Si framework; cross-hatched twinning characteristic

chemistry_notes: mica group; dioctahedral 2:1 phyllosilicate; common polytype 2M1
polymorph_details: 2M1 most common monoclinic polytype; 3T trigonal polytype also exists; 1M monolayer polytype; RELAB almost certainly 2M1
structure_notes: phyllosilicate; dioctahedral mica with K interlayer cation

chemistry_notes: olivine solid solution forsterite Mg2SiO4 to fayalite Fe2SiO4; RELAB samples are mostly forsteritic Fo80-99
polymorph_details: forsterite to fayalite complete solid solution at magmatic temperatures; ringwoodite is high-pressure spinel-structure polymorph not relevant here
structure_notes: nesosilicate; isolated SiO4 tetrahedra; Mg-Fe solid solution

chemistry_notes: K-feldspar; monoclinic partially ordered polymorph; intermediate between microcline and sanidine
polymorph_details: orthoclase partially ordered monoclinic vs microcline fully ordered triclinic vs sanidine fully disordered monoclinic high-T; RELAB one sample described as anorthoclase
structure_notes: monoclinic K-feldspar; partially ordered Al-Si framework

chemistry_notes: SiO2 polymorph series; alpha-quartz stable below 573C; beta-quartz above
polymorph_details: alpha-quartz trigonal P3121 stable below 573C; beta-quartz hexagonal P6222 above 573C; both may be present in RELAB
structure_notes: tectosilicate; framework of corner-sharing SiO4 tetrahedra; chiral space group

chemistry_notes: TiO2 polymorphs: rutile stable; anatase I41/amd and brookite Pbca are metastable
polymorph_details: rutile is the thermodynamically stable TiO2 polymorph at all T at 1 atm; anatase and brookite are metastable
structure_notes: most common TiO2 polymorph; tetragonal oxide with 3-fold coordinated O

chemistry_notes: spinel group; normal spinel; FeAl2O4 hercynite and Fe2TiO4 ulvospinel are related; RELAB includes ulvospinel
polymorph_details: spinel-hercynite MgAl2O4-FeAl2O4 solid solution; ulvospinel Fe2TiO4 is titanomagnetite end-member; no polymorphs at STP
structure_notes: normal spinel structure; cubic closest-packed oxygen with tetrahedral and octahedral cations
